title: Rezoning to allow housing at 158-06 Northern Boulevard, Queens
summary: This zoning map amendment would change R5B, C1-2, and R2 districts to R7A and C2-4 districts at 158-06 Northern Boulevard in Murray Hill, Queens. It would enable a 10-story mixed-use building with about 76 apartments, including 19 income-restricted units, and ground-floor commercial space. The City Council held a public hearing on August 12, 2026 and the Land Use Committee recommended approval with modifications on September 24, 2026.
